segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קפב
כָּל מַה שֶּׁהָעוֹלָם מְדַבְּרִים בְּכָל יְמֵי הַסְּפִירָה, הֵם מְדַבְּרִים רַק מֵהַסְּפִירָה שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם, וּמִי שֶׁהוּא מֵבִין יוּכַל לִשְׁמֹעַ וְלֵידַע זֹאת, אִם יַטֶּה אָזְנוֹ הֵיטֵב לְסִפּוּרֵי דִּבְרֵיהֶם, יִשְׁמַע שֶׁהֵם מְדַבְּרִים רַק מֵהַסְּפִירָה שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם:
segments.en: Sometimes the light of the Tzadik is so very very great — that it is impossible for the smaller one to receive the Tzadik's great light in his place — because of the excess of light. Therefore the great one is compelled to lower and humble oneself before the small one and go to him — so that through this the light decreases somewhat — so that the small one can receive it. And this is the aspect of: in the place of His greatness — there we find His humility.
